name: Peker Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi Anonim Sirketi
summary: Peker Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi Anonim Sirketi engages in the real estate investment business in Turkey, England, and Germany. The company qualifies as a real estate investment trust for federal income tax purposes. It generally would not be subject to federal corporate income taxes if it distributes at least 90% of its taxable income to its stockholders. The company was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Istanbul, Turkey.
